pipelines.name: qcam1
pipelines.pipeline: rtspsrc location=rtsp://mediaserver:8554/queuing-cam1 add-reference-timestamp-meta=true latency=200 ! decodebin3 ! sscape_timestamp_capture name=timesync ! gvadetect scheduling-policy=latency batch-size=1 inference-interval=1 model=/home/pipeline-server/models/huggingface/OpenVINO_yolox_tiny-fp16-ov/yolox_tiny.xml device=GPU inference-region=0 ! queue ! gvametaconvert add-tensor-data=true name=metaconvert ! sscape_post_inference_data_publish name=datapublisher ! appsink sync=true

metadatagenpolicy.description: One of detectionPolicy (default), detection3DPolicy, reidPolicy, classificationPolicy, ocrPolicy

publish_image.description: Publish annotated JPEG to scenescape/image/camera/<cameraid> each frame

detection_labels.description: Comma-separated allow-list of detection categories (e.g. "person,car"). Empty publishes all.
